statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-47680 is fixed in fluxcd/source-controller 1.8.5. The 1.6.x and 1.7.x image lines track their upstream minor release lines, and no fixed 1.6.x or 1.7.x patch release is available. Moving these variants to 1.8.5 would cross minor lines and change the published version track, so the older minor lines remain under investigation while awaiting upstream patch releases.
